title: Local, Extensible AI Agent for Automated Code Review
oneLiner: Goose runs locally as a general-purpose AI agent, configured via prompts and workflows to analyze code changes, identify bugs, and suggest improvements during the review process.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: Goose runs locally as a general-purpose AI agent, configured via prompts and workflows to analyze code changes, identify bugs, and suggest improvements during the review process.
steps: Configure it with code review guidelines
Point it to a specific PR or directory
Review the generated feedback and suggested patches.
configSnippet: "Review the changes in this PR for security vulnerabilities, adherence to our style guide, and potential performance bottlenecks."
limitations: Local execution limits access to heavy compute resources
effectiveness depends on the quality of the provided review guidelines.
